faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for OPGC Deputy General Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online submission of applications for the Deputy General Manager – Ash Utilization post is 06 October 2026. Candidates should ensure their applications are submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in OPGC Deputy General Manager Recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Deputy General Manager – Ash Utilization in the Odisha Power Generation Corporation Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Deputy General Manager post at OPGC?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Deputy General Manager – Ash Utilization position must not exceed 50 years of age. There are no specific age relaxations mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Any Discipline) from a recognized College/University to be eligible for the Deputy General Manager – Ash Utilization role.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Deputy General Manager position?
faq.answer: The fixed CTC for the Deputy General Manager – Ash Utilization post is Rs. 19,00,000/- per annum, with an additional variable pay of up to 19%.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for OPGC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the OPGC Deputy General Manager – Ash Utilization recruitment is online. Candidates need to apply through the official OPGC website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Deputy General Manager post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Deputy General Manager – Ash Utilization position primarily involves a Personal Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the OPGC Deputy General Manager – Ash Utilization Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without any fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for OPGC recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for Odisha Power Generation Corporation (OPGC) recruitment and other details is www.opgc.co.in. You can find the application link there.

faq.question: Q10. What experience is required for the Ash Utilization role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 15 years post-qualification experience is required, including 3 years in ash utilization or management, preferably in a thermal power plant or similar industry.
